content: Merged PR #3 (ctx-0001/fix-ci-clippy-fmt) via squash to main at 42c938b4f6c54b73dbe31c1eb3d44f40de5bd83d. Root cause: just check runs fmt-check before clippy, so CI never reached the workspace's clippy::pedantic debt (set to warn at workspace level, but upgraded to hard error by CI's -D warnings clippy invocation) until fmt-check was fixed first. Fixed fmt (cargo fmt --all), added # Errors docs to 22 functions, backtick-quoted 4 doc-markdown items, added 2 #[must_use], merged 3 sets of identical match arms, fixed 3 range off-by-ones, replaced 1 redundant closure, reordered 1 const before statements, and justified 2 long scanning functions with scoped #[allow(clippy::too_many_lines)]. No behavior change. All CI checks green: Quality gates, MSRV 1.85, Linux/Windows/macOS check+test, actionlint, CodeQL, CodeRabbit (no actionable findings, pre-merge checks 5/5 passed).
